title: Mobile release sync (HELD-OUT fixture)
note: Never used to choose any parameter. The diarization threshold is tuned on sample_meeting and only REPORTED here. Deliberately different from the tuning fixture: different voices, a different number of speakers (4 vs 3), and many very short turns ('Great.', 'Agreed.') which give the noisiest embeddings. If the threshold only works on the audio it was tuned on, this is where it shows.

lines.speaker: Meera
lines.text: Morning everyone. Quick sync on the mobile release. Tom, how is the build looking?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The build is green. We fixed the crash on older Android devices yesterday.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The payment screen still feels slow. Users are waiting almost four seconds.

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: That's the API call. We fetch the full order history before rendering anything.

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: Yes. I can change it to load the history after the screen appears.

lines.speaker: Meera
lines.text: Do that. Dev, can you have it ready by Thursday?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'll also update the crash dashboard so we can watch the new version.

lines.speaker: Meera
lines.text: Sounds good. Lena, could you run another usability test next week?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Should we also redesign the onboarding flow?

lines.speaker: Meera
lines.text: Not now. Let's keep this release small.

ground_truth.note: Owners here are recoverable ONLY with diarization plus evidence-based naming: each owner speaks a first-person commitment, and is addressed by name earlier in the meeting. Used by Phase 2.

action_items.task: Change the payment screen to load order history lazily
action_items.naming_evidence: 'Dev, can you have it ready by Thursday?' -> next speaker answers 'Thursday works.'
first-person 'I'll also update...'; Tom was addressed by name in turn 1 and the next speaker answered
'Lena, could you run another usability test next week?' -> next speaker: 'Sure, I'll book five participants.'

decisions.statement: Load the payment screen order history lazily

decisions.why: TRAP: proposed by Tom, explicitly declined ('Not now').
